title:
Transform for defining the content of the Non-Operational Summary section in the Inference step
Expects an object `params` as input with the following properties:
- `isBulk` (boolean): whether the user is working with a single asset or bulk assets
- `singleAssetNonOpMaskExpression` (string): the non-operational mask expression for a single asset
- `bulkAssetNonOpMaskExpression` (string): the non-operational mask expression for bulk assets
This transform returns either `singleAssetNonOpMaskExpression` or `bulkAssetNonOpMaskExpression` based on the value of `isBulk`
name: InferenceNonOpSummaryTransform
